name: Scope
text: I’ll extract the raw AUDIO+VISUAL from the provided video file (`watch_analysis_input.mp4`) using `ffmpeg` to generate lossless streams: `audio.wav` (48 kHz, 16-bit PCM) and `visual.mkv` (raw YUV420 frames). name: Frame
text: Frame: You’re assuming `gemini-2.0-flash` can reliably parse raw YUV420 frames without chroma subsampling artifacts or frame drops—where’s the validation that the local CLI wrapper preserves sync between `audio.wav` and `visual.mkv`?
